say:2:1711167001:1.text: I can feel it. The deathly presence that clung to my body is gone. In its place is a warmth I've nearly forgotten... like the first light of dawn.
say:2:1711167001:1.source_cn: 我能感觉到……那股盘踞在身体里的阴冷死气消失了。取而代...

say:3:1711167002:1.text: Dura has smiled upon us, Maximilian. You made it through.
say:3:1711167002:1.source_cn: 艾雅眷顾，马克西姆，你终于挺过来了。

say:4:1711167003:1.text: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.
say:4:1711167003:1.source_cn: 这不仅仅是圣光的仁慈吧？梅林，还有你……莫德琳。
say:4:1711167003:1.male: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.
say:4:1711167003:1.female: This was more than the blessing of the Divine Light, wasn't it? Merlin... and you, Gwendolyn.

say:6:1711167005:1.text: The details can wait. Until this life force fully settles within you, you need to keep your breathing steady.
say:6:1711167005:1.source_cn: 这些细节晚些再谈。在这股生命力完美契合你的身体之前，你...

say:7:1711167006:1.text: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
say:7:1711167006:1.source_cn: 梅林，能劳烦你再确认一下马克西姆的身体状况吗？我只相信...
say:7:1711167006:1.male: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
say:7:1711167006:1.female: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.

choice_prompt:8:1711167006.male: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.
choice_prompt:8:1711167006.female: Merlin, could you examine him once more? I trust only your judgment.

say:9:1711167007:1.text: Empowered by that immense life force, his heart beats strongly, and his body has been completely healed.
say:9:1711167007:1.source_cn: 在那股强大的生命力滋养下，他的心脏搏动有力，受损的身体...

say:13:1711167010:1.text: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
say:13:1711167010:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最...
say:13:1711167010:1.male: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
say:13:1711167010:1.female: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.

choice_prompt:14:1711167010.text: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们付出了怎样的努力，但是，梅林，请接受我最诚挚的感谢。
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.male: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.
choice_prompt:14:1711167010.female: I cannot imagine what it cost to save me. But Merlin, please accept my deepest gratitude.

say:15:1711167011:1.text: You have saved both the empire and my life time and time again. You are the closest friend the Lightbearer royal family has ever known.
say:15:1711167011:1.source_cn: 你一次次拯救了帝国，拯救了我，你是耀光王室最亲密的朋友。

say:16:1711167014:1.text: But for now, enjoy this moment of peace. There is a mountain of state affairs waiting for your attention; you won't be resting for long.
say:16:1711167014:1.source_cn: 好了，马克西姆，享受这短暂的轻松吧。还有一堆复杂的政务...

say:17:1711167015:1.text: These past few years have been hard on you.

say:18:1711167016:1.text: But before that... I'd like to see Orion and Peggy.
say:18:1711167016:1.source_cn: 不过，在那之前，我想见见奥利安和佩吉——

say:20:1711167012:1.text: Gwendolyn... I can tell you've done something incredibly dangerous behind my back.
say:20:1711167012:1.source_cn: 莫德琳……我能感觉到，你瞒着我做了一件极其危险的事。

say:21:1711167013:1.text: ... I will tell you and Peggy everything, I promise.
say:21:1711167013:1.source_cn: ……我会把一切都原原本本地告诉你和佩吉的，我保证。

choice:14:1:2.text: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.
choice:14:1:2.source_cn: 你最该感谢的是莫德琳
choice:14:1:2.male: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.
choice:14:1:2.female: The one you should thank most is Gwendolyn.
